label: Illustration and art style
description: Non-photographic styles by family: anime, illustration, comic, cartoon, painting, drawing, print, graphic, game, 3D, historic and craft. Bind only when the prompt asks for a drawn, painted or animated image; choose the family from the prompt.
notes: DRAFT. Never drawn for a prompt that doesn't ask for a non-photo image: no default shares. The writer picks the family (where={"family": ...}); the draw varies the style inside it. Each value says what the style looks like, so it works on models that don't know the style's name. No artist or studio names. art.medium keeps bare physical media.
